'''Susukigawa Shrine''' (須須岐水神社) is the name of a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}.

* {{ill|Susukigisui Shrine (Matsumoto City)|ja|須々岐水神社 (松本市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susukigawa Shrine (Matsumoto)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11664481}} (すすきがわじんじゃ) - A {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Matsumoto, Nagano|en|Matsumoto, Nagano|qid=Q213324|lt=Matsumoto, Nagano}}, {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture}}. The registered name of the religious corporation is '''須須岐水神社'''.
* {{ill|Susu Kizumi Shrine (Chikuma City)|ja|須須岐水神社 (千曲市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susukigawa Shrine (Chikuma)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q85884529}} (すすきみずじんじゃ) - A {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Chikuma, Nagano|en|Chikuma, Nagano|qid=Q179757|lt=Chikuma, Nagano}}, {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture}}.
